cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need your venue approval to store Tuesday's rain in this cup. The wedding lawn must stay dry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tuesday hasn't happened. Shall I fill the cup so you can demonstrate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, the rain needs room before it learns to fall. Please leave the cup empty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've another wedding Wednesday. Will a rubber lid stop it leaking overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use Thursday's drought for the seal. Rubber only holds rain that's already fallen. Initial the lid design too, please.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects B's water demonstration and A5 rubber seal, making presumed specialist knowledge shape repeated requests for approval of stranger weather handling.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 filling proposal produces A3 empty-cup requirement; B4 rubber lid produces A5 future drought alternative and formal initial request.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to understand through demonstration; B4 protects the following wedding with a practical containment proposal.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 actual sealing material to explain a stranger future-weather rule and seek added approval.

specificity.evidence: A1 venue approval and dry wedding lawn establish roles; B4 second wedding supplies a real immediate concern.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 three short clauses each answer B4: replacement seal, why rubber fails, required approval.
